description: What changed in DC Hub since a timestamp: DCPI 7-day market movers, newly found facilities, and new M&A deals and news; keyed callers with saved sites also get per-site changes. Pass since as ISO-8601 or "24h" / "7d" (default 24h) and pass the response's generated_at back next time. Answers "what changed this week". Keyless calls return a preview.

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

since.description: Return changes since this ISO-8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or full datetime) or shorthand "24h"/"7d"; default 24h

name: get_changes
title: Get Changes
